description: SCIM user provisioning/deprovisioning for enterprise directory integration.

requirements.description: A SCIM 2.0 endpoint must allow enterprise identity providers (e.g., Azure AD, Okta) to provision, update, and deprovision users within a realm. Supported operations: create user, update user attributes, deactivate user, delete user, list users with filter. SCIM operations map to the realm-scoped user model. Deprovisioning must revoke all active sessions for the removed user. SCIM access is protected by API key or client-credentials bearer token.
requirements.deferred_reason: SCIM is an enterprise directory integration and is outside the local-first principal/delegation delivery.
requirements.revisit_trigger: An enterprise directory must provision and deprovision authenticator users automatically.
requirements.title: SCIM 2.0 User Provisioning and Deprovisioning for Enterprise Directory Integration

validation.notes: api/internal/scim/scim_test.go: SCIM User resource marshals and unmarshals correctly with required attributes (userName, emails, active)
api/internal/scim/scim_test.go: SCIM filter expression (e.g., userName eq 'alice') is parsed and applied correctly to the user store

api/handlers/scim/scim_e2e_test.go: POST /scim/v2/Users to create a user → user exists in SQLite for the realm; PATCH to deactivate → user cannot sign in; DELETE → user removed and all sessions revoked
api/handlers/scim/scim_e2e_test.go: call SCIM endpoint without authentication → 401; with an invalid bearer token → 401; with a valid API key scoped to SCIM role → 200

title: SCIM Provisioning
